autoText.en: Canadian citizens can work in Canada without a work permit.
autoText.ar: يحق للمواطنين الكنديين العمل في كندا دون تصريح عمل.
autoText.fr: Les citoyens canadiens peuvent travailler au Canada sans permis de travail.

rule.en: Without Canadian citizenship or permanent residency, we skip jobs in Canada that require either. If you need a new work permit, we also skip jobs that say they can't sponsor.
rule.ar: إذا لم تكن مواطناً كندياً أو مقيماً دائماً، نتخطى الوظائف في كندا التي تشترط ذلك. وإذا كنت بحاجة إلى تصريح عمل جديد، نتخطى أيضاً الوظائف التي تذكر أنها لا توفر الرعاية.
rule.fr: Sans la citoyenneté canadienne ou la résidence permanente, nous écartons les offres au Canada qui exigent l'une ou l'autre. Si vous avez besoin d'un nouveau permis de travail, nous écartons aussi celles qui indiquent ne pas pouvoir vous parrainer.

sensitive.notes: Canadian human rights codes (Canadian Human Rights Act; Ontario Human Rights Code and its employment-application guidance) treat age, sex, marital and family status, place of origin and citizenship as protected grounds, so applications do not ask for a photo, date of birth, marital status, nationality or place of birth. They ask 'Are you legally eligible to work in Canada?' and often 'Will you now or in the future require sponsorship / a work permit?'. Gender, Indigenous identity, disability and visible-minority/racialized status appear only as voluntary employment-equity self-identification (Employment Equity Act for federally regulated employers such as banks, telecoms, airlines and railways, and the Federal Contractors Program), always with a 'prefer not to answer' option; we treat this like US EEO and default to declining unless the user chooses otherwise. SIN is collected only after hire. Ontario employers with 25+ employees must, from 1 Jan 2026, put a pay range in public postings, say whether AI is used in screening, not require 'Canadian experience', and say whether the vacancy exists; BC also bans pay-history questions.

renewal.en: Your plan renews automatically at the same price, plus applicable taxes, until you cancel. Cancel online anytime in Settings, and we email you before a 4- or 12-month plan renews.

renewal.fr: Votre abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement au même prix, taxes applicables en sus, jusqu'à sa résiliation. Résiliez en ligne à tout moment dans les Paramètres ; nous vous prévenons par e-mail avant le renouvellement d'une formule de 4 ou 12 mois.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Toronto. I lead IFRS reporting and budgeting on SAP across business units and own the monthly close for a 40-person function. I built the rolling forecasts and variance analysis that cut our reporting time by a third, and I am looking for a Senior Financial Analyst or FP&A role in Toronto or hybrid across the GTA.

bio.fr: Analyste financier avec 8 ans d'expérience à Toronto. Je pilote le reporting IFRS et le budget sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction de 40 personnes. J'ai mis en place les prévisions glissantes et l'analyse des écarts qui ont réduit d'un tiers notre temps de reporting, et je recherche un poste d'analyste financier senior ou en FP&A à Toronto ou en hybride dans le Grand Toronto.

culture.notes: Mon–Fri work week. Two weeks' notice is the norm when resigning (senior finance roles sometimes give 3–4 weeks); Ontario and BC set no statutory notice for employees who resign, while some provinces (e.g. Alberta, Manitoba, Nova Scotia) require 1–2 weeks depending on length of service, and common law expects reasonable notice everywhere. Salaried staff are usually paid bi-weekly or semi-monthly. Pay is discussed as an annual base salary, often plus a bonus; Ontario (employers with 25+ staff, from 1 Jan 2026), BC, PEI and Newfoundland and Labrador require pay ranges in job ads. The CV is called a resume: 2 pages for 8 years of experience, reverse-chronological, quantified achievements, no photo, date of birth, marital status, nationality or SIN (city and province is enough). Cover letters are asked for more often than in the US, especially at federal and public-sector employers, but are optional at most large private employers. Ontario postings can no longer require 'Canadian experience'. French matters for roles in Montreal and Quebec (Charter of the French Language) and for bilingual federal roles in Ottawa; elsewhere it is usually 'an asset'. Applications go through ATS portals (Workday, SuccessFactors, Taleo) with screening questions on work eligibility and sponsorship; banks run background and credit checks after an offer.
